actions.action: Move plant closer to a bright south or west window
Rotate the plant every few weeks
Repot in spring into a pot 2-3 inches wider with drainage and fresh well-draining mix, checking roots
Fertilize lightly with diluted balanced fertilizer in spring and summer
Lift pot out of clear outer container and empty standing water
Use a saucer or cache pot with drainage layer instead
Check soil moisture 2 inches deep and water thoroughly when dry, letting it drain

reason: The answer blames light, slow pace and root-binding and never identifies the multiple tangled money trees; repotting might expose the roots but it never says to separate them, and its reassurance that slow growth is normal delays the real fix.
